parameters.question: Compare logistic regression test accuracy (cancer vs. normal, 70/30 split). The reported test accuracy must match the reference within +/-0.02; column labels and row order may differ.

Compare top-10 logistic regression genes (by absolute coefficient) for cancer vs. normal classification using a 70/30 split. Pass if at least 7 of the 10 genes overlap with the reference set and coefficients of overlapping genes are within +/-0.05. Column names and row/column order may differ, and rankings near rank 10 may vary with solver version.
